Hey Alex -

Appreciate the repro payload and the timing details - very helpful. Looping in Dev (our runtime engineer) and Neha (integration/embeddings lead) so we can triage. A few things to check while we look:

- Can you confirm SDK version and whether you're using the hosted API or Dedicated pool? (We often see slightly different routing behavior depending on Dedicated routing policies.)
- Please share the exact request headers (auth, any custom routing headers) if possible - that helps map to the serving logs.
- Try raising your client request timeout to 60s for both the embedding and reranker calls and re-run the repro; if this reduces the observed failures that points to an upstream timeout vs internal crash.
- If you can, try splitting the batch into two smaller batches (16) and see if the error still occurs.

Dev/Neha - initial ask: can we pull the logs for Alex's request time window (14:30-14:50 PDT) and see whether the 5xx is a 500 from our runtime or a 502/504 from an intermediate proxy? Also confirm model routing for the reranker call - if the SDK is requesting a new variant during high concurrency we could be hitting a warmup path that returns 5xx.

Alex - we'll prioritize this and get back with a repro plan within the next business day. If you can attach the full client logs (headers + timings) that will speed us up.

Best,

Marissa/Neha - quick triage notes after a first pass on the logs Alex sent:

- The 5xx pattern looks mixed: a few 500s that have an internal stack trace pointing to the reranker container OOM-freeze path, and a couple of 502s that appear to be gateway timeouts when fronting a cold reranker variant.
- Immediate mitigation: ask Finlytics to increase request timeout to 60s and try a run with smaller batches (16). Also recommend setting the SDK model routing hint to "stable-v1-reranker" to avoid warmup routing to experimental variants.
- For repro: I ran the attached repro_payload.json locally against a staging pool with concurrency 8 and saw 1/50 failures that matched the stack trace. Command we used:

  curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/embeddings 
    -H 'Authorization: Bearer <redacted>' 
    -H 'Content-Type: application/json' 
    -d @repro_payload.json 
    --max-time 60

- I'm opening internal ticket JIRA SUP-321 to track a possible warmup race in reranker routing. I'll attach the stack traces and the staging repro.

Next steps: Neha - can you run a controlled test against the routing pool Alex is hitting and confirm whether we can reproduce >1% failure at concurrency 8? If so, we'll schedule a hotfix to the variant selection logic.

- Dev

Alex - quick update after our initial triage: thanks for the logs, that made this straightforward. Dev reproduced the failure pattern in staging and identified two contributing factors: (1) occasional warmup routing to an experimental reranker variant under high concurrency and (2) client-side timeouts that were too short for some of the heavier reranker payloads.

Workaround we've validated:
- Set SDK request timeout to 60s (both embeddings and reranker calls).
- Add a routing hint to the SDK: model: "stable-v1-reranker" to avoid experimental variant warmup.
- If possible, reduce embedding batch size to 16 for now while we roll the fix.

We've prepared a short doc with the steps (redwood_workaround_steps.md) - attaching here. Dev has opened SUP-321 and we're tracking a short-term patch to variant selection logic. We'll schedule a brief postmortem with your engineering team to align on a permanent mitigation and rollout plan.

If you want, we can run a live test with you this afternoon - say 2pm PDT?

Thanks for the quick cooperation - we'll follow up with the patch ETA once SUP-321 has a triage.

Best,
